newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss private bank Pictet client assets up sharply.
newsitem.headline: Swiss private bank Pictet client assets up sharply.

text.p: The volume of client assets managed by leading Swiss private bank Pictet & Cie rose to 83 billion Swiss francs at end-1996 from 65 billion a year ago, a bank spokesman said.
The volume of institutional client assets under management stood at 32 billion Swiss francs at end-1996 and private client funds at 50 billion Swiss francs, said spokesman Ricardo Payro.
Wealthy individuals account for roughly 60 percent of the client assets managed by the Geneva-based bank and institutions around 40 percent.
Client assets include seven billion Swiss francs managed in Pictet's mutual fund family. The bank manages 55 mutual funds including the London-listed First Russian Frontiers Trust.
Pictet does not publish its results and revenues from private banking and asset management, commission income and client segmentation.

Private client assets under management in Switzerland are estimated at some $1.8 trillion although reliable data is not available. Bankers say Switzerland has recently lost some market share to other offshore centres.
